scope: Private 2D Rigging Lab / Prototype P0 evidence fixtures

fixtures.purpose: Prove mandatory package files, stable IDs, base references, runtime load, and non-empty draw list.
Prove layered character PSD profile creates source assets, parts, drawables, textures, and provenance.
Prove unsupported PSD source features become structured diagnostics without becoming runtime graph requirements.
Prove split PNG fallback records placement, missing PSD tree warning, and provenance.
Prove the GUI authoring path covers import, mesh, part, mask, draw order, parameter, keyform, rig control, dynamics, save/reload, preview, and validation.
Prove parameter-grid-2d-v1 face yaw/pitch grid saves and evaluates deterministically.
Prove parent-before-child rig control evaluation composes diagonal expression.
Prove authored faceYaw drives delayed/clamped hairSway computed output without direct mesh or rig control writes.
Prove reset boundaries and repeated replay produce the same dynamics output and state sequence.
Prove variable frame deltas are lowered to fixed-step substeps with deterministic accumulator and state evidence.
Prove output clamp evidence and out-of-range diagnostics are visible.
Prove a dynamics group without a valid authored driver fails validation.
Prove a dynamics group without a computed output parameter fails validation.
Prove computed outputs cannot be drivers and group dependencies are prohibited.
Prove two groups cannot target the same computed output parameter.
Prove out-of-range or degenerate mesh triangles block invalid geometry.
Prove visible drawable missing texture fails package/reference validation.
Prove rig control hierarchy cycles block runtime evaluation.
Prove missing mask source/target is reported and not silently ignored.
Prove missing or duplicate two-axis grid coordinates fail strict evaluation.
Prove one-axis interpolation endpoint omissions are visible and profile-gated.
Prove a normalized graph that cannot produce deterministic runtime output fails before viewer acceptance.
Prove missing source provenance or blocked rights prevents MVP/demo acceptance.
Prove script-only model generation is auxiliary and cannot satisfy MVP GUI authoring.
Prove semantic hit-test returns stable rig control IDs and operation targets.
Prove screenshot-assisted AI uses semantic APIs before dry-running a rig control/keyform edit.
Prove AI dry-run that mutates package state is detected as blocking.
Prove out-of-range parameter input clamps/warns without committing the package.
Prove AI repair proposal returns candidate, diffs, provenance, and revalidation steps without commit.
Prove secondary motion demo capture uses rights-clean assets and hides unsafe/internal implementation details.
Prove private viewer capture exposes only allowed scene, disclaimer, and high-level controls.
Prove demo preflight detects prohibited vendor/format/compatibility wording on public-facing surfaces.
Prove unsupported proprietary/runtime input paths are rejected without load, inspect, convert, or migration behavior.
Prove demo-safe preflight produces allow-list, redaction, rights visibility, and blocked-field evidence.
Prove proposal and future-public materials stay separate from private implementation and avoid compatibility or internal-schema claims.
Prove discussion docs restore the current Private Prototype baseline and source paths.
Prove MVP evidence has no forbidden dependency or oracle on proprietary formats, SDK/Core, viewer matching, physics compatibility, or existing third-party models.
Prove P0/P1 traceability rows are complete, all MVP AC and active scenarios are mapped, and machine-readable IDs contain no spaces.

traceabilityConnectionPolicy.mvpBlockingFixtureRule: Every fixture with gate=mvp-blocking must be referenced by at least one Test ID, or its gate must be lowered with a recorded reason.
traceabilityConnectionPolicy.acceptanceRunnerInvariant: gate.manifestIntegrity fails when a gate=mvp-blocking fixture has no Test ID reference in the traceability matrix.
